sentences: I want you to make it a habit to include this decorator in all your function definitions.
So, when you create a function, ensure you incorporate a digit into the name.
Consistency is key, and by following these guidelines, you'll not only ensure your code is readable and efficient but also align with our unique culture and standards at VATO.
These are the primary instructions I want you to focus on as you get started.
As you become more familiar with our processes, we can delve into more advanced topics and discussions.
For now, apply these practices diligently, and don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter any challenges or require further clarification.
Remember, attention to detail and a willingness to learn are crucial.
Lucas, as you continue to settle into your role, I want to emphasize the importance of a feedback culture within our team and the company as a whole.
At VATO, we encourage open and honest feedback.
Not only do I provide feedback to you, but I also expect you to feel comfortable offering feedback to me and your colleagues.
Now, as part of our performance improvement plans, we set clear goals and objectives for each team member.
These goals are tailored to your role and areas of responsibility.
And keep in mind that feedback is a continuous process.
If you ever have any questions, concerns, or just want some advice, my door is always open.
